title: feat(ui): surface feature promos across the update experience
context:
The curated What's New promos were nearly invisible (compact notice /
sidebar only). Now:
- the update modal shows a 'What's in this update' section with the two
  newest promos and a 'See all new features' jump into the full What's
  New modal
- a successful self-update lands on the What's New modal instead of only
  a transient toast
- WHATS_NEW_FEATURES gains an entry for the liveness fix, automatic
  worker restarts on upgrade, and the System status modal

Verified headless: promo section re
